finding: A failing complete-command assertion unwinds out of the internal two-run loop on its first execution. The panic hook and enclosing aggregate assertion print the same payload twice. These are two renderings of one execution. Successful cases do execute twice.
scope: All fresh wrappers using this helper have these semantics unless an independent second invocation is evidenced. Historical repetitions=2 fields derived solely from the duplicate payloads must be read as two log copies, not two failed native commands.
unchanged: Case membership, exact/failed counts, expected TS artifacts, actual comparison bytes and successful native repetition claims remain valid. Original-corpus tuple runners and the standalone list-comment-flags loop perform their own per-repetition capture and are not affected. All frozen historical artifacts are retained.
new_token_before: Two separately launched native jobs will establish the 54-case token-comment before; each failure then has two actual independent executions.
